name: The Syndicate Sting
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
Falconcrest sent some guys to do a handoff at the southern part of Thoradin's wall. I don't know what they're picking up. Must be good, because everyone involved has kept it a total secret. I don't think the guys picking it up even know what it is.

That's all I've got. Don't make me regret telling you that.
narrative.objectives: Break up the secret deal, and take the object being traded to the Syndicate. Then, return to Myrokos Silentform at Ravenholdt Manor.
